pages.text: The mod has its own advancements, under $(l)Reiko's Trains$(): putting a train on the track, opening the throttle, a tram, an electric under the wires, 90 km/h, coupling up, a car aboard a car transporter, a timetable, a route from a signal box, a turntable, an engine shed, and laying track with the track-laying wagon (a bridge, too).
